beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Tanmay Kulkarni, in for Humanitarians AI. One company discloses four of its own AI systems, and every write-up treats that as one company doing AI. I wanted to know what happens if you refuse to average them, and score each one on the same two axes instead: is the mechanism disclosed, and does a human check the answer before a customer hears it.

legibility.artifact: Portrait title card: 'One Company. Four AI Systems.' with the two axes named beneath, presenter name below that.

beats.narration_text: Lay four systems out that way and a pattern falls out fast. Athena: rich disclosure, and a human reviews every answer anyway. The HR tool and the complaints tool: thin, but internal, nobody outside needs to see them. And the one system that actually talks to customers directly: undisclosed mechanism, undisclosed outcome, nobody checking first. Same company. That's not an accident.

legibility.artifact: Portrait stacked matrix: four compact system rows, each with a one-line descriptor; the fourth (Financial Assistant) highlighted and visibly emptiest.

beats.narration_text: So that's exactly the system I built a tested pipeline around, because that's where an undisclosed boundary actually does damage, instead of just sitting there as a caveat.

legibility.artifact: Portrait pipeline: three stages stacked vertically (Intake / Retrieval / Authorization Gate), connected by downward arrows.

beats.narration_text: That pipeline passed every test on the first run, twenty-nine for twenty-nine. Then I attacked it on purpose with malformed input, and found the one failure that matters most: a bad date silently came back as no transaction found, for a transaction that was actually there. Not a crash. A confident, wrong answer, exactly the risk that empty row predicted. Fixed, named precisely, and re-tested: forty-nine for forty-nine, checked again independently just for this cut.

legibility.artifact: Portrait code card: the corrected intake.py docstring (re-wrapped for a narrow frame), then the two distinct reason strings, then '49 passed' terminal line — same corrected-file-only treatment as the long's B12/B13, no before/after diff.

beats.narration_text: That's one row, one bug, caught on purpose. The other three systems, the full pipeline, and the fix in full, all in The Emptiest Row. Tanmay Kulkarni, in for Humanitarians AI.

legibility.artifact: Portrait title card: 'The Emptiest Row' revealed for the first time, presenter name, handle.
